question: Which Indian musician is associated with the tabla?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zakir Hussain**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zakir Hussain** is a renowned **Indian tabla** virtuoso.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the greatest tabla players in the world.
 
• Zakir Hussain has received numerous awards, including the prestigious **Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan** from the Government of India.
 
• He has collaborated with many international artists and has significantly contributed to the global appreciation of Indian classical music.
 
• His father, **Ustad Alla Rakha**, was also a legendary tabla player.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan** was a legendary **shehnai **player.
 
• **Pandit Ravishankar** was a world-renowned **sitar **virtuoso.
 
• **Ilaiyaraja** is a famous Indian film composer and songwriter.
 
• The tabla is a traditional Indian percussion instrument used in various genres of Indian music, including classical, folk, and contemporary styles.
